(2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect plays as the topic shifts to credit card cancellation. The first male voice continues, joined occasionally by short interjections from another male speaker. (3) The audio texture transitions as a third male begins an anecdote, his voice carrying higher narrative arousal and fluctuation. A faint laughter sound effect is layered in for comedic punctuation. (4) The track cuts to a professional, calm female narrator voice describing bank features. The background music maintains its upbeat tempo but becomes more polished and corporate in feel. (5) Distinctive digital 'ping' and UI 'click' sound effects are integrated as different app features and notifications are highlighted on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses street-style interviews and personal anecdotes about financial scams and forgotten subscriptions to build relatability before introducing the CTBC Bank app's new security and notification features as a necessary solution.
